<parameter=code>
def snap(fr):
    seg = fr.segmentation
    boxes = [(n['pixels'], tuple(n['boundary'][0]), tuple(n['boundary'][-1])) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='c']
    dots = [tuple(n['boundary'][0]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']<=2]
    return boxes, dots
# observe 3 steps of harmless movement
for mv in ['LEFT','RIGHT','LEFT']:
    action([mv])
    boxes, dots = snap(current_frame)
    b16 = [b for b in boxes if b[1][0]==16 and b[1][1]==47]
    print(current_frame.step, "center?", [(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if current_frame.ascii.splitlines()[r][c]=='W'], "box16", b16, "bdots", dots)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
